The Alibaba bespoke arched doorway update you’ve all been asking for! 😁 I hope this helps explain more, the costs are for our size door so this would change depending on the size of your door. It’s easy to get a quote from them just message the manufacturer via Alibaba and they will get back to you very soon with a price and also all the options! We opted for it to be left wood colour but you can have it fully painted all included in the price. They are very helpful and they want to get it right so definitely worth having a chat with them. They have actually offered to completely replace the doors for us but we’re going to try some other options first. I really don’t want to be without them now and shipping takes AGES so we will try to sort on site. They are sending some of the wood stain to us so we can get the snapped frame fixed. The bowing could be more of an issue as the wood is hard, but it already seems to be settling now it’s in place and we just need to add the top & bottom bolts and this should help further. I’m honestly not worried at all though as the company has assured me they won’t stop communicating with me until I’m 100% happy! For these doors to be manufactured here in the UK it was looking to be around 4-5k so I’m very happy with our saving 🙏 in an ideal world I’d want to have them made locally but honestly at that point I couldn’t afford to have them so it was my only choice. The cost of renovation is crazy, it would have been cheaper to build a new house from scratch 😂😂 good job I love the old character! It will be worth it in the end as they all say 🙏
